title: Antidepressant effects of combined eucommia-gastrodia extract via modulation of the HIF-1alpha-EPO/cAMP-CREB-BDNF pathway: An integrated network pharmacology and in vivo study.
authors: Xue, Lanqiong; Pan, Zhuoyue; Liu, Yao; Gan, Qiuling; Liu, Dong; Liu, Dingding
one_liner_zh: 该文为中药提取物抗抑郁的网络药理学与动物实验研究，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: This study aims to elucidate the pharmacological basis and antidepressant mechanisms of a combined extract from Eucommia ulmoides Oliv. And Gastrodia elata Bl. (Eucommia-Gastrodia extract), employing an integrated strategy that combines UHPLC-QTOF-MS analysis, network pharmacology, molecular docking, and in vivo validation. METHODOLOGY: This research integrated computational approaches network pharmacology, molecular docking and in vivo experimental investigations. Initially, the active constituents of the EGE were identified through ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography coupled with quadrupole time-of-flight mass spectrometry (UHPLC-QTOF-MS). Potential targets related to depression were predicted using the Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology Database (TCMSP) and SwissADME. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks were constructed via the STRING database, followed by the development of a comprehensive "drug-active ingredient-target-disease" network. Functional annotation through Gene Ontology (GO) and pathway enrichment analysis based on the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) were conducted on the intersecting targets using the Database for Annotation, Visualization, and Integrated Discovery (DAVID). Molecular docking studies were erformed employing AutoDock software to validate the interactions. Finally, the antidepressant-like behavioral effects were evaluated in treated and non-treated corticosterone-induced mouse models using sucrose preference tests, forced swimming tests, open field tests, and tail suspension tests. The morphological impacts and molecular basis of disease on the hippocampal neurons were assessed using Hematoxylin and Eosin staining (HE) staining, Nissl staining, immunohistochemistry, and Western blot analysis to substantiate the identified through network pharmacology. RESULTS: Network pharmacology analysis revealed a complex interplay between identified active ingredients of Eucommia-Gastrodia extract and depression targets. From an initial pool of 131 active components, 34 identified as interacting with 233 shared depression related molecular targets. These targets were involved in 390 biological processes (BP), 60 cellular compounds (CC), 134 molecular functions (MF), and 148 KEGG-enriched signaling pathways. Molecular docking studies highlighted 20 principal compounds that bind to key targets such as AKT1, SRC, HIF-1, CREB, BDNF, and EPO. The Eucommia-Gastrodia extract alleviated depression like behaviors in a cortisol-induced mouse model, as indicated by increased sucrose preference and mobility time, etc. Additionally, the extract restored the levels of neurotransmitters 5-hydroxytryptamine (5-HT) and dopamine (DA), alleviated hippocampal neuronal damage, and increased the positive expression of EPO and BDNF in the hippocampus. Furthermore, treatment with the extract significantly upregulated the protein expression of HIF-1, EPO, EPOR, CREB, p-CREB, BDNF and p-TrkB, which were otherwise downregulated in cortisol-induced depressive mice. CONCLUSION: The results indicate that the Eucommia-Gastrodia extract containing bioactive compounds such as oxysophocarpine, aucubin, pinoresinol, leonurine, syringaresinol, formononetin, icaritin, casticin, and 6-gingerol mitigates cortisol-induced neurodegeneration and depressive-like behaviors. This effect is mediated through modulation of the of HIF-1alpha-EPO/cAMP-CREB-BDNF signaling pathways.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在通过整合UHPLC-QTOF-MS分析、网络药理学、分子对接和体内验证的策略，阐明杜仲（Eucommia ulmoides Oliv.）和天麻（Gastrodia elata Bl.）联合提取物（杜仲-天麻提取物）的药理学基础及抗抑郁机制。方法：本研究整合了计算方法的网络药理学、分子对接和体内实验研究。首先，通过超高效液相色谱-四极杆飞行时间质谱（UHPLC-QTOF-MS）鉴定了杜仲-天麻提取物中的活性成分。使用中药系统药理学数据库（TCMSP）和SwissADME预测了与抑郁症相关的潜在靶点。通过STRING数据库构建了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络，随后开发了全面的“药物-活性成分-靶点-疾病”网络。利用注释、可视化和综合发现数据库（DAVID）对交集靶点进行了基于基因本体论（GO）的功能注释和基于京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）的通路富集分析。使用AutoDock软件进行分子对接研究以验证相互作用。最后，在经皮质酮诱导的小鼠模型中，通过蔗糖偏好测试、强迫游泳测试、开放场测试和悬尾测试评估了治疗组和非治疗组的抗抑郁样行为效应。使用苏木精-伊红染色（HE染色）、尼氏染色、免疫组织化学和Western blot分析评估海马神经元的形态学影响和疾病的分子基础，以证实网络药理学所识别的结果。结果：网络药理学分析揭示了杜仲-天麻提取物已识别活性成分与抑郁症靶点之间的复杂相互作用。从初始的131个活性成分中，有34个被鉴定为与233个共享的抑郁症相关分子靶点相互作用。这些靶点涉及390个生物过程（BP）、60个细胞组分（CC）、134个分子功能（MF）和148条KEGG富集信号通路。分子对接研究突出了20种主要化合物，它们与关键靶点如AKT1、SRC、HIF-1、CREB、BDNF和EPO结合。杜仲-天麻提取物在皮质酮诱导的小鼠模型中缓解了抑郁样行为，表现为蔗糖偏好和活动时间增加等。此外，该提取物恢复了神经递质5-羟色胺（5-HT）和多巴胺（DA）的水平，减轻了海马神经元损伤，并增加了海马中EPO和BDNF的阳性表达。进一步地，提取物治疗显著上调了HIF-1、EPO、EPOR、CREB、p-CREB、BDNF和p-TrkB的蛋白表达，而这些在皮质酮诱导的抑郁小鼠中原本是下调的。结论：结果表明，含有氧化苦参碱、桃叶珊瑚苷、松脂素、益母草碱、丁香脂素、芒柄花素、淫羊藿素、蔓荆子黄素和6-姜酚等生物活性化合物的杜仲-天麻提取物，可减轻皮质酮诱导的神经变性和抑郁样行为。这一效应是通过调节HIF-1α-EPO/cAMP-CREB-BDNF信号通路介导的。
